tournament.name: South America Magic Series - Regional Championship

decks.notes: The deck focuses on using a toolbox of creatures with various abilities to create a combo that allows for versatility and resilience. By utilizing cards like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Chord of Calling, the deck can assemble different creature combinations to control the board and gain incremental advantage. The deck also includes sacrifice outlets like Blood Artist and Grist, the Hunger Tide to drain opponents' life totals while generating value from sacrificing creatures. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue opponents through the synergies of its creature toolbox and combo pieces.

The deck revolves around using cards like Grief, Oliphaunt, and Architects of Will to disrupt the opponent's hand and set up for a combo finish with Living End. Shardless Agent, Subtlety, and Street Wraith provide additional disruption and card draw, while Generous Ent and Curator of Mysteries help dig for combo pieces. Waker of Waves and Thundering Falls provide additional threats. Force of Negation protects the combo, while Violent Outburst is used to cascade into Living End. The mana base includes fetch lands and various dual lands to support the deck's color requirements.

This deck focuses on utilizing instant reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate to quickly bring back powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier from the graveyard. Fallaji Archaeologist and Tainted Indulgence provide additional ways to cheat creatures into play, while cards like Faithful Mending and Thoughtseize help to control the game and disrupt the opponent's plans. The deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats and close out the game before they have a chance to respond.

This deck focuses on using control elements to manipulate the battlefield and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It includes cards like Counterspell, Supreme Verdict, and Narset, Parter of Veils to control the pace of the game. The key card in the deck is The One Ring, which allows the player to generate value and outlast their opponent. The deck also utilizes a mix of lands and mana sources to ensure smooth gameplay and access to the necessary resources. Overall, the goal of this deck is to maintain control and ultimately emerge victorious.

This deck focuses on creating a powerful board presence with creatures that benefit from +1/+1 counters, taking advantage of Hardened Scales to double the number of counters they receive. The deck includes a variety of artifacts and lands that can generate additional value or protection for your creatures, as well as some disruption cards to control the opponent's game plan. By quickly building up your creatures with counters and utilizing synergies within the deck, you aim to overwhelm your opponent and secure the win.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cards that allow the player to cycle through their deck quickly and efficiently, while also disrupting the opponent's gameplay. The ultimate goal is to fill the graveyard with creatures and then cast Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield, creating a powerful board state. Cards like Subtlety and Violent Outburst help enable this combo, while Force of Negation provides protection. The deck also includes creatures like Curator of Mysteries and Grief to provide additional value and disruption to the opponent. The mana base includes lands that support the deck's strategy and provide the necessary colors for casting spells.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells, utilizing cards like Grief and Thoughtseize to strip away the opponent's resources. The deck also includes powerful threats like Dauthi Voidwalker and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to apply pressure early on. With a mix of targeted removal spells like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt, as well as larger threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, the deck can adapt its game plan based on the opponent's strategy. The mana base is built to support the deck's aggressive game plan while providing flexibility in casting spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing control elements such as counterspells and board wipes, while also utilizing powerful cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and The One Ring to dominate the game. The key strategy revolves around maintaining board control and disrupting the opponent's game plan, ultimately leading to a victory through card advantage and powerful late-game threats. The deck also includes a companion, Kaheera, the Orphanguard, to provide additional support and synergy with the rest of the cards in the deck.

This deck aims to quickly deploy aggressive creatures while utilizing powerful multicolored spells to overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a Companion allows for additional mana flexibility and potential combo synergy. The deck's strategy is to apply pressure early with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu, backed up by removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding provide additional disruption and protection, while Tribal Flames can deal significant damage based on the number of different land types controlled.

The deck focuses on playing low-cost aggressive creatures and spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It includes a variety of creatures with strong combat abilities and burn spells to remove blockers or finish off the opponent. The deck also utilizes Leylines to protect its creatures and Leyline of the Guildpact to boost their power. The mana base is designed to support a diverse range of colors for the spells and creatures. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion provides additional synergy and consistency to the deck.

This deck focuses on utilizing the synergy between land-based ramp cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to quickly assemble powerful combos using Primeval Titan and Amulet of Vigor. By generating multiple land drops per turn and tutoring for specific lands with cards like Expedition Map and Tolaria West, the deck aims to create a dominant board presence that can overwhelm opponents with massive creatures and tricky interactions. The inclusion of utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle adds extra versatility and resilience to the deck's game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly getting out powerful creatures like Scion of Draco and generating advantage through cascade effects like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and relentless assault, using cards like Crashing Footfalls and Leyline of the Guildpact to maintain board presence. The deck also includes control elements like Subtlety and Force of Negation to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain it throughout the game to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using equipment like Colossus Hammer and Kaldra Compleat to quickly deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent. By utilizing cards like Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic to search for and equip these powerful artifacts, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and unexpected assault. With additional support cards like Esper Sentinel and Spell Pierce for disruption, the deck seeks to control the game while setting up its game-winning combo. The deck's key strategy is to quickly assemble its combo pieces and deliver a lethal blow before the opponent can respond effectively.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures and then use Living End to return them all to the battlefield, overwhelming the opponent with a sudden swarm of creatures. The deck focuses on cycling cards and manipulating the graveyard to set up big plays and close out the game with powerful combo turns. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Force of Negation to protect its game plan and ensure a successful Living End resolution. Overall, this deck aims to leverage its graveyard resources for explosive and decisive victories.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with creature cards using cards like Shardless Agent, Subtlety, Grief, and Generous Ent. Once the graveyard is filled, the player can cast Living End to bring back all the creatures from the graveyard onto the battlefield, while also getting rid of any opponent's creatures on the board. This combo allows for a powerful and explosive play that can swing the game in the player's favor. Additionally, cards like Force of Negation provide protection and disruption for the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to mill the opponent's library as quickly and efficiently as possible, using cards like Ruin Crab, Hedron Crab, and Glimpse the Unthinkable. The deck also includes control elements like Drown in the Loch and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Surgical Extraction is included to remove crucial cards from the opponent's deck. The deck aims to win by emptying the opponent's library and forcing them to draw on an empty deck, leading to a victory through decking out.
